description: This file defines a shared informer factory for Kubernetes custom resource informers, including configuration options, lifecycle management, and accessors for specific informer types.

classes.name: sharedInformerFactory
classes.description: Implements the SharedInformerFactory interface, managing lifecycle and access to informers for different resource types.

methods.name: WithCustomResyncConfig
methods.description: Sets a custom resync period for specified informer types.

methods.name: WithTweakListOptions
methods.description: Sets a custom filter function for list options.

methods.name: WithNamespace
methods.description: Limits the factory to a specific namespace.

methods.name: WithTransform
methods.description: Sets a transform function for all informers.

methods.name: WithInformerName
methods.description: Sets the informer name used for metrics and identification.

methods.name: NewSharedInformerFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory for all namespaces with default resync.

methods.name: NewFilteredSharedInformerFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory with namespace filtering and list options.

methods.name: NewSharedInformerFactoryWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new factory with additional configuration options.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts all informers with a stop channel.

methods.name: StartWithContext
methods.description: Starts all informers with a context for cancellation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Marks the factory as shutting down and waits for goroutines to finish.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synced or stop channel is closed.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSyncWithContext
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synced or context is canceled.

methods.name: InformerFor
methods.description: Returns a shared informer for a given runtime object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: SecondExample
methods.description: Returns the second example informer interface.
